headline: Paytm Secures RBI Approval to Restart Digital Wallet Operations
summary: Indian fintech company Paytm received regulatory license approval from the Reserve Bank of India to resume operating its digital wallet payment business.
why: Paytm is a prominent digital payments ecosystem operator in India. Restored wallet permissions allow the company to rebuild transaction volumes and commercial unit economics.

impacts.name: One 97 Communications Ltd
impacts.why: Regulatory approval allows the company to re-engage market share in digital payment products.
